headline: Reserve Bank of New Zealand Files Disclosure Charge Against Westpac NZ
summary: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand has filed a formal charge against Westpac New Zealand Limited in the District Court relating to disclosure requirements.
why: Regulatory enforcement actions against major retail banks can impact institutional reputation, compliance costs, and banking sector oversight.

impacts.name: Westpac New Zealand
impacts.why: Regulatory charges and legal actions introduce operational and compliance risks for the bank.
